scenes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet with TRUE transparent background, no checkerboard painted in. Generate exactly NINE sequential full-scene animation frames in a strict 3 columns x 3 rows equal-cell grid, read left to right then top to bottom. Prefer a wide 1536x1024 output so each cell is landscape. No borders, labels, text, arrows or frame numbers. Input 1 is the definitive fox identity/proportions/outfit reference; input 2 is action storyboard only. Maintain original short legs, rounded head, orange fur, cream muzzle/tail tip, brown beret/artist vest, cream shirt and red scarf, brown paws, NO trousers or tall boots. High quality soft 3D rendered tactile fur and beautiful art props. CRITICAL animation registration: camera locked, identical orthographic scale in ALL nine cells, identical fox head size and limb length, identical floor baseline, do not resize to fit props. Fox standing height roughly 65% of cell height; keep 8% padding all sides, show every tail/ear/prop completely. Entire scene and all props must appear in every cell, stable coordinates. Small connected pose changes between frames, expressions progress naturally. No collage of differently scaled poses. The fox never grows or shrinks. Render clean transparent silhouettes. Scene sequence: Study sunflowers at the easel; lean closer wearing small round spectacles; blink thoughtfully; lift palette and brush; brush touches sunflower; short painting stroke; second stroke; lower brush; proudly open free paw to present. Easel stays on right, fox on left.
